parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of non-integer powers in the conversion matrix, but it may introduce behavioral regressions and lacks sufficient tests.

issues.description: The patch may break existing behavior by returning the original expression when non-integer powers are encountered, which could lead to unexpected results in other valid use cases.
The patch does not include any new tests to verify the correctness of the change, which is crucial for ensuring that the fix does not introduce new issues.
The patch introduces a non-minimal change by adding a conditional check and converting powers to integers, which may affect the readability and maintainability of the code.
